声音似乎很紧张。你的视野突然变得清晰。你在一个白色的房间里。当你的目光缓慢地扫视房间时，你注意到了一些奇怪的事情。房间的两侧排列着一系列玻璃吊舱。每个吊舱里都有一个人，每个人的头上都戴着某种形式的帽子。

“从模拟器里出来吧，拉尔夫！我们还得去买东西呢。”直到这时，你终于想起来了。

source:
”As expected, you've lost the 2000 election.”

This was hardly a surprise, considering the stranglehold that the two-party system holds on American politics. To make matters worse, you didn’t even get 5% of the popular vote, so the Green Party will have to do without federal matching funds.

Still, you’ve run a decent campaign, and your campaign has tried the best it could. You have a chance to cross that 5% threshold in the next election at least, considering you’ve been a perennial candidate for 8 years now. Good luck in 2004!
zh:
“不出所料，你输掉了 2000 年选举。”

考虑到两党制度对美国政治的束缚，这不足为奇。更糟糕的是，你甚至没有获得 5% 的普选票，因此绿党将不得不在没有联邦配套资金的情况下进行。

尽管如此，您的竞选活动还是不错的，并且您的竞选活动已尽了最大努力。考虑到你已经成为常年候选人 8 年了，你至少有机会在下一次选举中跨越 5% 的门槛。祝你2004年好运！

source: Today you have announced the selection of Dick Cheney as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择迪克·切尼作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: What key points will you emphasize as you accept your party's nomination for President of the United States?
zh: 当您接受贵党的美国总统提名时，您会强调哪些要点？

source: What is your overall strategy for the 2000 campaign?
zh: 2000 年竞选活动的总体策略是什么？

source: Do you have any plans to change American tax policy?
zh: 您有改变美国税收政策的计划吗？

source: Which of the following best describes your position on the $200 billion surplus that is projected for this year?
zh: 以下哪一项最能描述您对今年预计 2000 亿美元盈余的立场？

source: Do you believe that Elian Gonzalez should have been returned to Cuba?
zh: 您认为埃连·冈萨雷斯应该被送回古巴吗？

source: Do you have any thoughts on the Bill Clinton scandal that you would like to share?
zh: 您对比尔·克林顿丑闻有什么想法想分享吗？

source: Which of the following best describes your position on education?
zh: 以下哪一项最能描述您对教育的立场？

source: Which of the following best describes your position on Social Security?
zh: 以下哪一项最能描述您对社会保障的立场？

source: Did you support Bill Clinton's actions leading to the bombing of Serbia?
zh: 您支持比尔·克林顿导致轰炸塞尔维亚的行动吗？

source: What are your thoughts on the USS Cole bombing, which has killed 17 American sailors. How should we prevent such incidents of terrorism in the future?
zh: 您对造成 17 名美国水手死亡的科尔号航空母舰爆炸事件有何看法？今后应如何杜绝此类恐怖事件的发生？

source: What is your vision for the foreign policy of this country?
zh: 您对这个国家的外交政策有何看法？

source: Do you have anything to say about your alleged drug use in the 1970s?
zh: 对于您在 20 世纪 70 年代涉嫌吸毒的指控，您有什么要说的吗？

source: Another day, another rally on the campaign trail. What do you prefer to talk about today?
zh: 又一天，竞选活动中的另一场集会。今天你最想聊什么？

source: Do you support proposals to expand oil drilling in Alaska, and specifically in the Alaska National Wildlife Refuge?
zh: 您是否支持在阿拉斯加州，特别是在阿拉斯加州国家野生动物保护区扩大石油钻探的提议？

source: What do you think of proposals to build a sophisticated missile defense system in Eastern Europe?
zh: 您如何看待在东欧建立先进导弹防御系统的提议？

source: What is your position on abortion?
zh: 您对堕胎的立场是什么？

source: Do you have any plans to address or change immigration policy if elected President?
zh: 如果当选总统，您是否有计划解决或改变移民政策？

source: The Kyoto Protocol would commit the United States (along with many other countries) to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Would you support this plan as President?
zh: 《京都议定书》将要求美国（以及许多其他国家）承诺减少温室气体排放。作为总统，你会支持这个计划吗？

source: Do you think that new regulations from Bill Clinton have unfairly hurt coal-producing states?
zh: 您认为比尔·克林顿的新规定是否不公平地伤害了煤炭生产州？

source: Some suggest you lack the experience and qualifications for to be President. What do you say?
zh: 有人认为您缺乏担任总统的经验和资格。你怎么说？

source: In Texas, a man named James Byrd was brutally murdered in what many call a hate crime. What is your opinion of federal hate crime legislation?
zh: 在得克萨斯州中，一名名叫詹姆斯伯德的男子在许多人所谓的仇恨犯罪中被残酷谋杀。您对联邦仇恨犯罪立法有何看法？

source: It is November 2nd, only five days before the voting. News has just broken that you were arrested for drunken driving in 1976. What is your response?
zh: 现在是 11 月 2 日，距离投票只剩下五天了。刚刚传出您在1976年因酒后驾车被捕的消息，您对此有何回应？

source: Where will you make the final stop(s) of your campaign before the voting begins?
zh: 投票开始前，您的竞选活动最后一站将在哪里？

source: We need to expand benefits for Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid. We can use the surplus as well as defense cuts to balance these increases.
zh: 我们需要扩大社会保障、联邦医疗保险和医疗补助的福利。我们可以利用盈余和国防削减来平衡这些增长。

source: I can certainly see the need for some legislation, but it should be addressed at the state level.
zh: 我当然可以看到一些立法的必要性，但应该在州一级解决。

source: We should enact tax cuts to return this money to the American people. My plan will reduce the burden for all Americans who currently pay income tax.
zh: 我们应该实施减税，将这笔钱返还给美国人民。我的计划将减轻所有目前缴纳所得税的美国人的负担。

source: We should try to keep things as they are. The economy has been unusually good the past few years, and we already have a large federal debt to pay down.
zh: 我们应该尽量保持现状。过去几年经济异常好，我们已经有巨额联邦债务需要偿还。

source: I would prefer to see us allocate this money to new and existing government programs so that all Americans can share in our prosperity.
zh: 我希望看到我们将这笔钱分配给新的和现有的政府项目，以便所有美国人都能分享我们的繁荣。

source: I believe that we need to return control of education to the states and to the people. I would end the Department of Education as President.
zh: 我认为我们需要将教育的控制权归还给各州和人民。我将结束教育部总统职务。

source: Many schools are squandering the resources of the federal government. I support providing school vouchers directly to parents, so that they can choose where their child goes.
zh: 许多学校正在浪费联邦政府的资源。我支持直接向家长提供学券，以便他们可以选择孩子去哪里。

source: We need more spending for America's struggling schools, and national standards and testing to identify and fix poor performers. Every child deserves a strong, functional school to attend.
zh: 我们需要为美国陷入困境的学校提供​​更多支出，并需要国家标准和测试来识别和解决表现不佳的学生。每个孩子都应该就读一所实力雄厚、功能齐全的学校。

source: We need to increase pay for teachers and increase funding for the Department of Education. I don't support nationwide standards or testing -- they will distort the learning process and lead to education by rote.
zh: 我们需要增加教师工资并增加教育部的资金。我不支持全国性的标准或测试——它们会扭曲学习过程并导致死记硬背的教育。

source: The Social Security system is a financial time bomb. We need to get rid of it, or at the very least cut its benefits significantly.
zh: 社会保障系统是一个金融定时炸弹。我们需要摆脱它，或者至少大幅削减它的好处。

source: The average worker would do much better if their money was invested in the stock market. I support a plan to allow workers to contribute at least some of their Social Security contribution to an individual investment account.
zh: 如果普通工人的钱投资于股票市场，他们会做得更好。我支持一项计划，允许工人将至少部分社会保障捐款存入个人投资账户。

source: We need to increase benefits for Social Security. Many people can barely survive on the monthly payment, while we spend billions on the military and run a huge budget surplus.
zh: 我们需要增加社会保障的福利。许多人靠每月的付款勉强生存，而我们在军事上花费数十亿美元并拥有巨额预算盈余。

source: The Cold War is over. We should cut defense spending and stop operating so many bases overseas. I would pull troops out of places like Germany and Okinawa, where we are no longer defending anything.
zh: 冷战结束了。我们应该削减国防开支并停止运营如此多的海外基地。我会从德国和冲绳等地撤军，因为我们在那里不再保卫任何东西。

source: America should remain tough, but humble. I am concerned about some of our recent interventions in places like Somalia and Serbia.
zh: 美国应该保持强硬，但谦虚。我对我们最近在索马里和塞尔维亚等地采取的一些干预措施感到担忧。

source: We need to remain an engaged, committed defender of human rights in the world. We should do everything possible to secure the friendship of nations like Russia and China, and to prevent atrocities and genocide in the developing world.
zh: 我们需要继续成为世界上积极、坚定的人权捍卫者。我们应该尽一切可能确保俄罗斯和中国等国家的友谊，并防止发展中国家发生暴行和种族灭绝。

source: I would focus on removing dictators like Saddam Hussein and Kim Jong Il from power. They threaten the stability of the world and perpetrate evil upon their people.
zh: 我将专注于消除像萨达姆·侯赛因和金正日这样的独裁者。他们威胁世界的稳定并对人民施行邪恶。

source: Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
zh: 比尔·克林顿是美国的耻辱，他的弹劾是当之无愧的。我认为他应该被免职。

source: I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
zh: 我认为我们不需要详细说明这一点。我向美国人民保证，当我担任总统时，我将恢复白宫的荣誉和尊严。

source: I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
zh: 我是我自己的人。我在很多方面尊重比尔·克林顿，但在本案中缺乏他的个人行为。

source: This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
zh: 这不是问题。比尔·克林顿是过去五十年来最好的总统之一，我们应该关注他的政策和成功，而不是他的个人事务。

source: Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
zh: 将埃连送回古巴是不合理的。我不支持克林顿政府的这一决定。

source: We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
zh: 我们应该少谈论埃利安，而更多地谈论我扩大这个国家伟大繁荣的计划。

source: The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
zh: 法律就是法律。埃利安和他的父亲一起属于古巴。这些问题从来都不容易，但克林顿政府和珍妮特·雷诺做了他们必须做的事情。

source: This was an issue that had no bearing on the security of the United States. We also ruined any chance of mediation by insisting on the autonomy of Kosovo.
zh: 这是一个与美国安全无关的问题。我们还坚持科索沃自治，从而破坏了任何调解的机会。

source: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
zh: 这当然有助于推翻斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇，但作为总统，我将确保美国在干预外国事务之前谨慎行事。

source: I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
zh: 我支持我们在这个剧院的行动。我们以最小的成本阻止了潜在的种族灭绝并将独裁者绳之以法。

source: The bombing of Serbia killed many innocent civilians and increased antagonism with Russia and China. I believe military intervention should be a last resort.
zh: 对塞尔维亚的轰炸造成许多无辜平民死亡，并加剧了与俄罗斯和中国的对抗。我认为军事干预应该是最后的手段。

source: We need huge tax cuts across the board. Corporate, personal, and capital gains taxes should be slashed. This will further expand the economy through increases in investment.
zh: 我们需要全面大幅减税。公司税、个人税和资本利得税应该大幅削减。这将通过增加投资进一步扩大经济。

source: My budget will cut taxes and return a portion of our budget surplus to the American people. Everybody who pays taxes will receive a reduction.
zh: 我的预算将减税并将部分预算盈余返还给美国人民。每个纳税人都将获得减免。

source: We have a plan for middle class tax cuts. But it would be irresponsible to make huge changes while we still have a large debt.
zh: 我们有一个针对中产阶级减税的计划。但在我们仍然背负巨额债务的情况下做出巨大改变是不负责任的。

source: I have no plan to cut taxes. If anything, we might need some increases to strengthen Social Security.
zh: 我没有减税计划。如果有的话，我们可能需要一些增加来加强社会保障。

source: I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.
zh: 我支持对发动这次攻击的人做出强烈、压倒性的反应。任何窝藏此类恐怖分子的政府都应该被推翻，即使这需要美国军队的支持。

source: We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.
zh: 我们需要做两件事——首先，我们需要更好的程序来确保我们在危险地区的部队更好地保护自己。其次，我们将调查这次袭击事件的责任人，无论是基地组织还是其他组织，并对其进行相应的打击。

source: This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
zh: 这次袭击是一场悲剧，但它强调了美国需要采取更加有限的外交政策。冷战已经结束，在世界这么多地方部署军队没有任何意义。

source: A crime is a crime, no matter what the motive is. I do not support ideas that some victims should be held in higher regard than others.
zh: 犯罪就是犯罪，无论动机是什么。我不支持某些受害者应该比其他受害者受到更高尊重的想法。

source: I support increased federal hate crime legislation. No American should ever feel like a target of intimidation because of their identity.
zh: 我支持增加联邦仇恨犯罪立法。任何美国人都不应该因为自己的身份而感到自己成为恐吓的目标。

source: We have no proof that global warming exists, and we should be expanding our production of coal and oil to obtain energy independence. I would not surrender the sovereignty of our nation for such trivial objectives.
zh: 我们没有证据表明全球变暖存在，我们应该扩大煤炭和石油的生产以获得能源独立。我不会为了这些微不足道的目标而放弃我们国家的主权。

source: I would not. The Protocol exempts 80% of the world, including major population centers such as China and India, from compliance, and would cause serious harm to the US economy.
zh: 我不会。该议定书免除了世界80%的国家的遵守义务，其中包括中国和印度等主要人口中心，这将对美国经济造成严重损害。

source: It seems very unlikely that the Senate will ever come up with the votes to ratify this agreement. I don't know how my support or opposition would change that equation.
zh: 参议院似乎不太可能投票批准该协议。我不知道我的支持或反对会如何改变这个等式。

source: We have worked for years with many other countries to negotiate this agreement. I support the environment and believe the Protocol should be ratified.
zh: 我们多年来一直与许多其他国家合作谈判该协议。我支持环保并认为应该批准该议定书。

source: We have almost 9 million illegal immigrants in this country. I support stronger enforcement of immigration laws to reduce this number.
zh: 这个国家有近 900 万非法移民。我支持加强移民法的执行以减少这一数字。

source: All people contribute to a prosperous America. I support a combination of stronger immigration enforcement with a path to citizenship for people currently in the country. We can do better than we did with the 1986 law.
zh: 所有人都为繁荣的美国做出贡献。我支持将更强有力的移民执法与目前在该国的人们获得公民身份的途径结合起来。我们可以比 1986 年法律做得更好。

source: I prefer to focus on making responsible use of our budget surplus and securing prosperity for the next generation of Americans.
zh: 我更愿意专注于负责任地利用我们的预算盈余并确保下一代美国人的繁荣。

source: We need a path to citizenship for those in the country, and we need a system of work permits and strict enforcement on employers, so that immigrants do not depress American wages. We should increase aid to Latin America to reduce the rich-poor divide in our economies.
zh: 我们需要为国内的人提供一条获得公民身份的途径，我们需要一个工作许可制度和对雇主的严格执行，这样移民就不会压低美国的工资。我们应该增加对拉丁美洲的援助，以缩小经济中的贫富差距。

source: Over a million unborn children are killed every year in this country. We need judges who will overturn Roe v. Wade, or we need a Constitutional Amendment to end the practice of abortion.
zh: 这个国家每年有超过一百万未出生的婴儿被杀害。我们需要能够推翻的法官 罗诉韦德案，否则我们需要宪法修正案来结束堕胎的做法。

source: I am a pro-life candidate for President, but I understand that we have certain legal protections in place. At the very least, we can end taxpayer funding for this practice.
zh: 我是反堕胎总统候选人，但我了解我们有一定的法律保护。至少，我们可以终止纳税人对这种做法的资助。

source: My goal as President will be to reduce abortions in this country to the lowest level possible. We can increase education and funding for contraception, to reduce unwanted pregnancies. I might be open to ending late-term abortions.
zh: 作为总统，我的目标是将这个国家的堕胎率减少到尽可能低的水平。我们可以增加避孕教育和资金投入，以减少意外怀孕。我可能愿意结束晚期堕胎。

source: I strongly support the right of a woman to choose. We need to defend this right, and we should increase funding for women's health services, unconditionally.
zh: 我强烈支持女性的选择权。我们需要捍卫这一权利，我们应该无条件增加对妇女健康服务的资金投入。

source: Absolutely. Anything we can do to work towards energy independence in this country is a positive step. Oil and coal are the foundation of any energy policy, and should be exploited as much as possible.
zh: 当然。我们为实现这个国家的能源独立所做的一切都是积极的一步。石油和煤炭是任何能源政策的基础，应尽可能地加以开发。

source: This is fine with me, but it is a small part of the overall solution. We need to drill wherever we can, while encouraging innovation in other sectors of the energy market.
zh: 这对我来说没问题，但它只是整个解决方案的一小部分。我们需要尽可能地进行钻探，同时鼓励能源市场其他领域的创新。

source: I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
zh: 我反对这些计划。 ANWR是美国的环境宝藏，任何开采所获得的石油都将相对有限。

source: This is a giveaway to oil companies that will not resolve America's underlying energy issues. We need more government investment in renewable energy sources, and strict regulations on oil and coal.
zh: 这是对石油公司的赠品，无法解决美国的根本能源问题。我们需要政府对可再生能源进行更多投资，并对石油和煤炭进行严格监管。

source: Absolutely. This is just another example of meddling that harms the economy, hurts energy production, and puts hard-working Americans out of work.
zh: 当然。这只是损害经济、损害能源生产并使辛勤工作的美国人失业的干预的另一个例子。

source: Unfortunately, coal is one of the dirtiest forms of energy in existence. I don't see how we can continue to rely on it for the majority of America's energy needs.
zh: 不幸的是，煤炭是现存最肮脏的能源形式之一。我不明白我们如何继续依赖它来满足美国的大部分能源需求。

source: This is a necessary step to protect our allies in Europe from current and future threats to their security. I will strongly support this as President.
zh: 这是保护我们的欧洲盟友免受当前和未来安全威胁的必要步骤。作为总统，我将坚决支持这一点。

source: As President, I will reach out to key military leaders for their advice on this issue.
zh: 作为总统，我将向主要军事领导人寻求有关此问题的建议。

source: To defend against whom? The Cold War is over and we should be working with Russia, not against them. This is just more unnecessary military spending.
zh: 防御谁？冷战结束了，我们应该努力工作 与 俄罗斯，不反对他们。这只是更多不必要的军费开支。

source: After eight years of scandals and excesses from the Clinton Administration, I will return this country to its rightful principles -- small government, clean moral conduct, and the freedom of the people.
zh: 经过八年的克林顿政府的丑闻和暴行之后，我将使这个国家恢复其合法的原则——小政府、廉洁的道德行为和人民的自由。

source: I will ask the American people if they really want to vote for a third term of Bill Clinton, and remind them that I am the true conservative alternative. I will remind them of Al Gore's campaign finance violations and frequent misrepresentations to the American people.
zh: 我会问美国人民是否真的想投票支持比尔·克林顿的第三个任期，并提醒他们我是真正的保守派选择。我会提醒他们阿尔·戈尔的竞选财务违规行为以及对美国人民频繁的虚假陈述。

source: Conservatism doesn't mean anger and divisiveness. I will govern as a sensible, pragmatic conservative and pass reforms that are broadly acceptable to the American people. I will return a part of our historic surplus to all of our hard-working families who pay taxes.
zh: 保守主义并不意味着愤怒和分裂。我将作为一个明智、务实的保守派来执政，并通过美国人民广泛接受的改革。我将把我们历史盈余的一部分返还给所有勤劳纳税的家庭。

source: As President, I will work with Republicans and Democrats to advocate for programs that all Americans can approve of. We need to move past the divisiveness of recent years and strengthen our economy, Social Security, education, and Medicare. I would prefer to return some of the budget surplus to the people, but I am willing to compromise to get things done.
zh: 作为总统，我将与共和党和民主党合作，倡导所有美国人都能批准的计划。我们需要克服近年来的分歧，加强我们的经济、社会保障、教育和联邦医疗保险。我宁愿将部分预算盈余返还给人民，但为了完成任务我愿意妥协。

source: We will emphasize that a vote for Al Gore is a vote for the scandals and liberal policies of the Clinton Administration. We offer a true, conservative alternative to the American people. I will discuss my evangelical Christianity and small-government beliefs.
zh: 我们将强调，投票给阿尔·戈尔就是投票给克林顿政府的丑闻和自由主义政策。我们为美国人民提供了一个真正的、保守的选择。我将讨论我的福音派基督教和小政府信仰。

source: It is important to nail down our conservative base by emphasizing tax cuts, my evangelical background, opposition to abortion, a strong defense, and limits to government spending. We will ignore Bill Clinton, but paint Al Gore as out of touch.
zh: 重要的是通过强调减税、我的福音派背景、反对堕胎、强有力的防御和对政府支出的限制来巩固我们的保守派基础。我们将忽略比尔·克林顿，但将阿尔·戈尔描绘为脱离实际。

source: We need to run an attacking campaign against Al Gore. We will expose his misstatements and emphasize that his proposals will squander our budget surplus and greatly increase the size and scope of government.
zh: 我们需要对阿尔·戈尔发起攻击活动。我们将揭露他的错误陈述，并强调他的建议将浪费我们的预算盈余，并大大增加政府的规模和范围。

source: I will campaign as a conciliatory, moderate conservative. I will emphasize my record as the Governor of Texas, and my support across different groups and parties. We will minimize any talk of budget cuts or overturning existing programs. We will resist the temptation to criticize Bill Clinton.
zh: 我将作为一个和解的、温和的保守派参加竞选活动。我将强调我作为得克萨斯州州长的记录，以及我对不同团体和政党的支持。我们将尽量减少任何有关削减预算或推翻现有计划的讨论。我们将抵制批评的诱惑比尔·克林顿。

source: I plead guilty. I don't have experience with the broken political culture of Washington, unlike my opponent. I will clean this system up when I am President.
zh: 我承认。与我的对手不同，我没有在华盛顿那种腐败失灵的政治文化中混迹的经验。当上总统后，我会整顿这个体系。

source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, conservative candidate who will control spending and return our surplus to the American people.
zh: 让我们好好演讲一下，我是如何成为主流保守派候选人的，他将控制支出并将我们的盈余返还给美国人民。

source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to reform Social Security, education, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
zh: 国内问题。让我们谈谈我的改革计划社会保障、教育和联邦医疗保险，以确保美国未来的繁荣。让我们提醒选民，这些都是常识性的提案，几乎对所有人都有吸引力。

source: We need to attack Al Gore's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
zh: 我们需要攻击阿尔·戈尔对环境、能源、税收、支出以及我国正确方向的看法。他与美国人民脱节。

source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Governor of Texas. I will remind voters that I have worked across the aisle, won support from many different groups, and will be a uniter, not a divider, when I arrive in Washington.
zh: 我会强调担任得克萨斯州州长的政绩与经验，提醒选民：我曾跨越党派合作，赢得过许多不同群体的支持。到了华盛顿，我将团结人民，而不是制造分裂。

source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my brother Jeb in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
zh: 我将在佛罗里达州中与我的兄弟 Jeb 一起度过竞选的最后阶段。这种状态对于我们的机会至关重要。

source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can bring into the fold.
zh: 我将出现在宾夕法尼亚州中，并在俄亥俄州中度过后半天。这是我们可以纳入的两个巨大州。

source: The upper Midwest is key. I will start in Iowa, travel through Wisconsin, and end up in Michigan.
zh: 中西部北部是关键。我将从艾奥瓦州开始，经过威斯康星州，最后到达密歇根州。

source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but with one last push we can make them go Republican.
zh: 我们需要关注密苏里州、田纳西州和阿肯色州等状态。克林顿可能在四年前赢得了他们，但只要最后一搏，我们就能让他们成为共和党人。

source: This could destroy my campaign in the final days. We must accuse the Gore campaign of leaking this to discredit my candidacy, and challenge their credibility and timing.
zh: 这可能会在最后几天毁掉我的竞选活动。我们必须指责戈尔竞选团队泄露此信息以抹黑我的候选资格，并挑战他们的可信度和时机。

source: I will admit my guilt and apologize to the American people for hiding this story. I will say it was a mistake in judgment to believe that this would not come to light in our modern media environment.
zh: 我会承认自己有罪，并向美国人民道歉，因为我隐瞒了这个故事。我想说的是，相信这不会在我们的现代媒体环境中曝光，这是一个错误的判断。

source: I will emphasize that I made mistakes in the past that I'm not proud of, and that I've always been up front with the American people about that fact. I will also remind the voters that I have not drank alcohol since 1986, and question why this came out five days before the election.
zh: 我要强调的是，我过去犯过一些我并不感到自豪的错误，而且我一直向美国人民坦白这一事实。我还会提醒选民，我自1986年以来就没有喝酒，并质问为什么在选举前五天发布这一消息。

source: I refuse to comment on this issue. My spokeswoman will remind the American people that the real issue is who will be a better President for the country.
zh: 我拒绝对此问题发表评论。我的发言人将提醒美国人民，真正的问题是谁将成为国家更好的总统。

source: These stories are absolutely false. I never used illegal drugs and those who say I did are completely mistaken.
zh: 这些故事绝对是假的。我从未使用过非法药物，那些说我使用过的人是完全错误的。

source: I did some things when I was younger that I'm not proud of. But my record in office and my conduct over the past two decades is clear. I stopped drinking in 1986 and never looked back.
zh: 我年轻时做了一些我并不自豪的事情。但我的执政记录和过去二十年的行为是清楚的。我从 1986 年开始戒酒，之后就再也没有回头。

source: These types of stories should be irrelevant to a political campaign. We've all done things when we were young that we're not proud of.
zh: 这些类型的故事应该与政治运动无关。年轻的时候，我们都曾做过一些不值得骄傲的事情。

source: This is nonsense. I have served as the Governor of Texas, the second largest state in the country, for nearly six years.
zh: 这是无稽之谈。我担任该国第二大州得克萨斯州的州长已近六年。

source: James Buchanan had a lot of experience in government. Abraham Lincoln didn't. So what if I'm a little unseasoned? I have the instincts for the job.
zh: 詹姆斯布坎南在政府部门拥有丰富的经验。亚伯拉罕·林肯没有。如果我有点缺乏经验怎么办？我有这份工作的直觉。

source: Dick Cheney is a principled conservative leader. The two of us will govern over a conservative, patriotic administration. Let's turn the page from the Clinton era.
zh: 迪克·切尼是一位有原则的保守派领袖。我们两人将领导一个保守、爱国的政府。让我们从克林顿时代翻过这一页。

source: Dick Cheney is the best person for the job. He has served in all kinds of roles and performed admirably in every case.
zh: 迪克·切尼是这项工作的最佳人选。他曾担任过各种角色，并且在每一个案件中都表现出色。

source: This is a good, conservative answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
zh: 这是一个很好的、保守的答案，可以激励你的基础。一如既往，确保你在撤军和吸引犹豫不决的选民之间找到适当的平衡。

source: This is a good, mainstream answer. As always, make sure you balance the need to win moderates against the desires of your core supporters.
zh: 这是一个很好的主流答案。一如既往，确保在赢得温和派的需要与核心支持者的愿望之间取得平衡。

source: You're certainly getting attention in the news for this stance, but it is not a mainstream position in your party. Perhaps this will establish you as an independent thinker...
zh: 您的这一立场肯定会引起新闻关注，但这并不是您所在政党的主流立场。也许这会让你成为一个独立的思想家......

source: It's important to stick to your principles, but your answer is not calibrated to win a majority of voters in November.
zh: 坚持你的原则很重要，但你的答案并没有经过调整以赢得 11 月的大多数选民。

source: A lot of people say that Social Security is the third rail of American politics. You may have made some hard-core conservatives happy, but the vast majority of voters disagree with your stance.
zh: 很多人说社会保障是美国政治的第三轨。你可能让一些顽固的保守派感到高兴，但绝大多数选民不同意你的立场。

source: Foreign policy is not a huge issue in this election. Just avoid saying anything too hawkish or dovish so that you don't attract negative attention.
zh: 外交政策在这次选举中并不是一个大问题。只是避免说过于鹰派或鸽派的话，以免引起负面关注。

source: This is a good, mainstream answer on foreign policy.
zh: 这是关于外交政策的一个很好的主流答案。

source: You are getting your core voters fired up, but it might be better not to mention Bill Clinton. He's a popular figure in America and you are trying to unseat his heir apparent.
zh: 你正在让你的核心选民兴奋起来，但最好不要提及比尔·克林顿。他在美国是一位受欢迎的人物，而你正试图推翻他的法定继承人。

source: For a Republican, there's nothing wrong with giving a pat phrase and moving to the next topic when it comes to Bill Clinton.
zh: 对共和党人而言，谈到比尔·克林顿时，讲几句套话就转向下一个话题，并无不妥。

source: The Elian issue is simple -- a small, politically active minority in Florida wants him to remain. There is also the issue of supporting or opposing Bill Clinton to consider.
zh: 埃利安问题很简单——佛罗里达州中一小部分政治活跃的少数派希望他留下来。还有支持或反对比尔·克林顿的问题需要考虑。

source: Support and opposition to the Serbia air strikes is all over the place. Mainstream politicians support the action, while a combination of anti-war leftists and anti-Clinton Republicans oppose it.
zh: 对塞尔维亚空袭的支持和反对无处不在。主流政客支持这一行动，而反战左翼人士和反克林顿共和党人则反对。

source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Buchanan or even Gore.
zh: 什么？！你很快澄清了这一说法，但为时已晚。你已经严重损害了你在基础选民中的信誉，并且可能失去了很多选票给布坎南甚至戈尔。

source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
zh: 美国人普遍对比尔·克林顿有不错的看法，你的答案可能不太适合时代。然而，这肯定会激励你的保守派基础。

source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton and Al Gore, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
zh: 美国人普遍对比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔有不错的看法，你的答案可能不太适合时代。然而，这肯定会激励你的保守派基础。

source: This is a theme that will establish you as a moderate, mainstream conservative. To run a national campaign against a popular Administration, this might be the right tone to strike.
zh: 这个主题将使您成为温和的主流保守派。要开展一场全国性的运动来反对一个受欢迎的政府，这可能是正确的打击基调。

source: Americans dislike partisan rancor, but is your speech the answer? What are the details? You also have to worry about alienating conservative supporters.
zh: 美国人不喜欢党派仇恨，但你的演讲就是答案吗？详情为何？你还必须担心疏远保守派支持者。

source: It is probably a bad idea to run against the record of Bill Clinton, given his popularity. Better to just ignore him and focus on other issues.
zh: 考虑到比尔·克林顿的受欢迎程度，与他的记录竞争可能是一个坏主意。最好忽略他并专注于其他问题。

source: Ignoring Clinton is a good idea, and the rest of this strategy establishes your conservative bona fides. It could be interesting.
zh: 忽略克林顿是个好主意，该策略的其余部分将建立您保守的诚意。这可能很有趣。

source: It is risky to run an overtly negative campaign after the recent Clinton-Gingrich battles. It might be better to focus on your own plans for government.
zh: 在最近的克林顿-金里奇战斗之后进行公开的负面战役是有风险的。最好专注于你自己的政府计划。

source: This is a good strategy, if the goal is moving past the Clinton years and presenting yourself as an acceptable mainstream leader.
zh: 如果目标是超越克林顿岁月并将自己呈现为可接受的主流领导者，那么这是一个很好的策略。

source: Alright. Way to get that crowd fired up.
zh: 好的。让那群人兴奋起来的方法。

source: Hopefully you can pull Florida out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把佛罗里达州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: Hopefully you can pull Ohio and Pennsylvania out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: Hopefully you can pull these states out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把这些州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: This is widely seen as a poor response to the news that broke. Hopefully you can still win the election.
zh: 这被广泛认为是对突发新闻的不良反应。希望你仍然能赢得选举。

source: Your response struck some as too passive and apologetic. Definitely not in character for a potential world leader.
zh: 你的回应让一些人觉得过于被动和抱歉。绝对不符合潜在世界领导人的性格。

source: This is probably the best you could do under the circumstances. Good luck!
zh: 这可能是在这种情况下你能做的最好的事情。祝你好运！

source: Americans want to hear you address this personally, and not watch as you hide behind a spokeswoman.
zh: 美国人希望听到您亲自解决这个问题，而不是看着您躲在发言人后面。

source: Many people are questioning your credibility and fitness based on this issue. There are too many sources and witnesses for you to deny these things completely.
zh: 很多人基于这个问题质疑你的可信度和健康度。有太多的消息来源和证人让你无法完全否认这些事情。

source: This is probably the best response you can give, given some of these things that happened when you were young and immature.
zh: 考虑到您年轻且不成熟时发生的一些事情，这可能是您能给出的最佳回应。

source: It might be better to admit that something happened and address it.
zh: 承认发生了一些事情并解决它可能会更好。

source: This is a good, solid response to the question.
zh: 这是对这个问题的良好、可靠的回答。

source: Interesting answer, though a few people are mumbling about you comparing yourself to Lincoln.
zh: 有趣的答案，尽管有些人在嘀咕你将自己与林肯进行比较。

source: This is a good, liberal answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
zh: 这是一个很好、自由的答案，可以激励你的基础。一如既往，确保你在撤军和吸引犹豫不决的选民之间找到适当的平衡。

source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Nader or even Bush.
zh: 什么？！你很快澄清了这一说法，但为时已晚。你已经严重损害了你在基础选民中的信誉，并且可能失去了很多选票给纳德甚至布什。

source: It would probably be better not to repudiate Clinton so harshly. Not only is he broadly popular, but you also served with him for eight years.
zh: 最好不要如此严厉地否认克林顿。他不仅广受欢迎，而且您还与他一起服役了八年。

source: It is a net positive that you are embracing Clinton's legacy. Just keep in mind that there's a trade-off -- some left-wing voters believe that Clinton is too moderate.
zh: 您正在接受克林顿的遗产，这是一个积极的结果。请记住，这是一个权衡——一些左翼选民认为克林顿过于温和。

source: It does not look good for Al Gore, noted environmentalist, to come out against the Kyoto Protocol.
zh: 著名的环保主义者阿尔·戈尔站出来反对《京都议定书》，这看起来不太好。

source: This is a good hedge. Even John Kerry voted against the Protocol.
zh: 这是一个很好的对冲。甚至约翰·克里也投票反对该协议。

source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. There's no reason to make an unforced error like this.
zh: 移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。没有理由犯这样的非受迫性错误。

source: Interesting ideas, but immigration is not a big issue in this election. But no harm, no foul.
zh: 有趣的想法，但移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。但没有伤害，没有犯规。

source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. Better to just focus on your core platform.
zh: 移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。最好只专注于您的核心政治纲领。

source: What?! The purpose of your candidacy is to provide a solid, left-wing alternative to the two main parties. People are wondering what you meant by taking this stance.
zh: 什么？！您参选的目的是为两个主要政党提供一个可靠的左翼替代方案。人们想知道你采取这种立场是什么意思。

source: This is a good, left-wing answer that will motivate your base.
zh: 这是一个很好的左翼答案，可以激励你的基础。

source: This is a good answer for a Green Party candidate.
zh: 对于绿党候选人来说，这是一个很好的答案。

source: The best course for a Green Party candidate is to oppose foreign intervention under almost all circumstances.
zh: 对于绿党候选人来说，最好的做法是在几乎所有情况下反对外国干预。

source: It's probably best to ignore Bill Clinton, and focus your statements on Bush, Gore, and the two-party system in general.
zh: 最好忽略比尔·克林顿，并将您的陈述集中在布什、戈尔和一般的两党制度上。

source: This stance helps you in a couple of coal states, but definitely raises eyebrows among the mainstream left.
zh: 这种立场对一些煤炭州有帮助，但肯定会引起主流左派的不满。

source: Today you have announced the selection of John Danforth as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择约翰·丹福思作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Do you support the air strikes and sanctions that have been levied against Iraq, with the goal of weakening Saddam Hussein?
zh: 您是否支持对伊拉克实施空袭和制裁，以削弱萨达姆·侯赛因？

source: What is your opinion on the performance and conduct of our current President, Bill Clinton?
zh: 您对我们现任总统比尔·克林顿的表现和行为有何看法？

source: Should low-income parents be able to use federal vouchers to send their children to private schools?
zh: 低收入父母是否应该能够使用联邦代金券将孩子送到私立学校？

source: Do you have any plans to help America's seniors better pay for vital prescription drugs?
zh: 您是否有计划帮助美国老年人更好地支付重要的处方药费用？

source: I don't think we need to make huge changes to a system that works for the majority of the people it is supposed to help.
zh: 我认为我们不需要对一个适用于大多数应该帮助的人的系统进行巨大的改变。

source: I believe we should address this problem directly -- by adding a prescription drug benefit to Medicare.
zh: 我认为我们应该直接解决这个问题——通过在联邦医疗保险中添加处方药福利。

source: We need more funding for Medicare. We need to hold providers accountable when they fall short, by curbing excess profits for pharmaceuticals and targeting HMOs that drop seniors.
zh: 我们需要更多资金用于联邦医疗保险。我们需要通过限制药品的超额利润并针对导致老年人流失的健康维护组织（HMO），在供应商未能达标时追究其责任。

source: We should incorporate Medicare into a larger, universal single-payer health insurance program. Many proposals I hear about are overly cautious and lacking in ambition.
zh: 我们应该将联邦医疗保险纳入一个更大的、通用的单一付款人健康保险计划。我听到的许多建议都过于谨慎且缺乏雄心。

source: I believe we haven't gone far enough on this issue. Saddam Hussein is a destabilizing leader, and he must be removed for the Middle East to truly prosper.
zh: 我相信我们在这个问题上做得还不够。萨达姆·侯赛因是一位破坏稳定的领导人，必须将他赶下台，中东才能真正繁荣。

source: We are following the right course in Iraq. We must enforce our agreement to prevent Saddam from acquiring weapons of mass destruction. Saddam is allowing the sanctions to harm his people for his own selfish purposes.
zh: 我们在伊拉克走的是正确的道路。我们必须执行我们的协议，防止萨达姆获取大规模杀伤性武器。萨达姆为了自己的自私目的而允许制裁伤害他的人民。

source: The United States is much too entangled in the Middle East. We should pull back from the region and end sanctions in Iraq. I might remind people that these sanctions have killed hundreds of thousands of Iraqi children.
zh: 美国在中东问题上纠缠得太深了。我们应该从该地区撤军并结束对伊拉克的制裁。我可能会提醒人们，这些制裁已经导致数十万伊拉克儿童死亡。

source: I see how this is appealing to some conservatives, but it still represents the interference of the federal government in education.
zh: 我看到这对一些保守派来说很有吸引力，但它仍然代表了联邦政府对教育的干预。

source: I strongly support this idea and will work to implement it as President. All parents deserve to choose where their child will attend school.
zh: 我强烈支持这个想法，并将作为总统努力实现它。所有父母都有权选择孩子上学的地方。

source: This plan will take money out of the public schools and will not fix the underlying problem of poor education in the United States.
zh: 该计划将从公立学校中抽走资金，并且不会解决美国教育质量差的根本问题。

source: My campaign isn't about Bill Clinton. I prefer to focus on the future, and on the issues that will strengthen our country and economy.
zh: 我的广告系列与比尔·克林顿无关。我更喜欢关注未来，关注那些能够增强我们国家和经济实力的问题。

source: Bill Clinton's partisan attacks have degraded the political culture of our country. I will be a uniter, not a divider, when I am in the White House.
zh: 比尔·克林顿的党派攻击已经退化了我们国家的政治文化。当我在白宫中时，我将成为一个团结者，而不是一个分裂者。

source: Bill Clinton pushed through a tax increase, new gun control laws, a lot of environmental regulations, and has been subject to numerous fundraising and corruption allegations. Not to mention his infamous personal conduct in the White House.
zh: 比尔·克林顿推动通过了增税、新的枪支管制法和大量环境法规，并受到了大量筹款和腐败指控。更不用说他在白宫中臭名昭著的个人行为。

source: We can all learn a lot from Bill Clinton's ability to compromise with Congress and pursue a moderate political agenda. I will do the same as President.
zh: 我们都可以从比尔·克林顿与国会妥协并追求温和政治议程的能力中学到很多东西。我也会像总统那样做。

source: John Danforth is a strong, religious man with a good heart. He is a wonderful example of a leader that conservatives can produce.
zh: 约翰·丹福思是一个坚强、虔诚、心地善良的人。他是保守派可以培养的领导人的绝佳典范。

source: John Danforth has served his home state of Missouri well. I think he has a record that all Americans can get behind.
zh: 约翰·丹福思很好地服务了他的家乡密苏里州。我认为他拥有所有美国人都可以追随的记录。

source: The consensus view is that the U.S. should continue to strike foreign terrorist networks. Voters don't want to see a U.S. pullback, nor do they wish to see a large-scale conflict or ground invasion.
zh: 共识是美国应该继续打击外国恐怖网络。选民不希望看到美国撤军，也不希望看到大规模冲突或地面入侵。

source: This is a good idea for dealing with any issues or questions relating to Bill Clinton.
zh: 这是处理与比尔·克林顿相关的任何问题或疑问的好主意。

source: A lot of moderates blame Republicans as much as or more than Bill Clinton for the partisanship of the 1990s.
zh: 许多温和派对 20 世纪 90 年代党派之争的指责与比尔·克林顿一样多，甚至更多。

source: This message appeals to solid conservatives only. Clinton is too popular elsewhere.
zh: 此消息仅对坚定的保守派有吸引力。克林顿在其他地方太受欢迎了。

source: Some people agree, but many conservatives are wondering what was so moderate about Bill Clinton.
zh: 有些人同意，但许多保守派想知道比尔·克林顿为何如此温和。

source: Some pro-life groups are concerned about your selection of Tom Ridge as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 一些反堕胎团体对你选择汤姆·里奇作为竞选搭档感到担忧。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Do you believe it is appropriate for Hillary Clinton to run for Senate in the state of New York -- a state where she has never lived?
zh: 您认为希拉里·克林顿在纽约州州（她从未居住过的州）竞选参议员合适吗？

source: What do you think of Bill Clinton's recent action to tap the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to reduce the costs of home heating, particularly in the northeast?
zh: 您如何看待比尔·克林顿最近利用战略石油储备来降低家庭供暖成本（尤其是东北地区）的行动？

source: Do you support additional gun control measures in this country? Can you give some specifics of what you want?
zh: 您支持这个国家采取额外的枪支管制措施吗？你能具体说明你想要什么吗？

source: I do not support new gun control laws. We need better enforcement of the existing laws we have. The Assault Weapons Ban should be allowed to expire.
zh: 我不支持新的枪支管制法。我们需要更好地执行现有法律。应该允许攻击性武器禁令到期。

source: I support the right to bear arms, with a couple of common-sense restrictions. We need background checks at gun shows, and better prevention measures to keep guns away from the mentally ill.
zh: 我支持携带武器的权利，但有一些常识性限制。我们需要在枪支展上进行背景调查，并采取更好的预防措施，让枪支远离精神病患者。

source: We need to renew the Assault Weapons Ban and make it permanent. I support other measures such as trigger locks to reduce gun violence in this country.
zh: 我们需要更新攻击武器禁令并将其永久化。我支持其他措施，例如扳机锁，以减少这个国家的枪支暴力。

source: The only way we will end gun violence in this country is through large-scale legislation and the confiscation of troublesome weapons. The Second Amendment was never meant to apply to individuals.
zh: 我们结束这个国家枪支暴力的唯一方法是通过大规模立法和没收麻烦的武器。第二修正案从来就不是为了适用于个人。

source: This seems like another attempt by the Clintons to stretch the rules. Hillary Clinton is clearly from Arkansas and should seek office from that state if she so desires.
zh: 这似乎是克林顿夫妇再次试图扩大规则。希拉里·克林顿显然来自阿肯色州，如果她愿意的话，应该从该州寻求职位。

source: I don't have any comment. I trust the people of New York to make the right decision on this issue.
zh: 我没有任何评论。我相信纽约州的人们会在这个问题上做出正确的决定。

source: Off the record, I am uncomfortable with this, but I prefer not to make a public statement about it.
zh: 私下里，我对此感到不舒服，但我不想对此发表公开声明。

source: The Clintons have added a greatly to the political life of the United States. I support Hillary Clinton in her campaign.
zh: 克林顿夫妇为美国的政治生活增添了极大的色彩。我支持希拉里·克林顿的竞选活动。

source: This is clear political gamesmanship which I cannot support in good conscience. The Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. Furthermore, why did Clinton announce this decision so close to the election?
zh: 这明显是政治游戏，我凭良心无法支持。该储备金只能在国家紧急情况下使用。此外，为什么克林顿在临近选举时宣布这一决定？

source: I understand the impulse to help America's families, but the Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. This action is unwise.
zh: 我理解帮助美国家庭的冲动，但储备金只能在国家紧急情况下使用。这种行为是不明智的。

source: Oil prices have spiked to nearly $40 a barrel. We need to help hard-working Americans in states like New Hampshire by making temporary allowances from our reserve.
zh: 油价已飙升至每桶近 40 美元。我们需要通过从我们的储备金中提供临时津贴来帮助新罕布什尔州等州辛勤工作的美国人。

source: Good people don't agree on every issue. Tom Ridge understands that we will run a pro-life administration.
zh: 好人不会在所有问题上都达成一致。汤姆·里奇了解我们将管理一个反堕胎政府。

source: Tom Ridge has served his home state of Pennsylvania well. It would be a shame to ignore that because of a litmus test on one issue.
zh: 汤姆·里奇很好地服务了他的家乡宾夕法尼亚州。因为对一个问题的试金石而忽视这一点将是一种耻辱。

source: There's not much to be gained by commenting on the Clintons or inserting yourself into New York politics.
zh: 评论克林顿夫妇或将自己卷入纽约州政治并没有多大收获。

source: A lot of oil companies and national security hawks are upset with this move, and not too thrilled that you have embraced it.
zh: 许多石油公司和国家安全鹰派人士对这一举措感到不安，并且对您接受它并不太兴奋。

source: As a Democrat, there's nothing wrong with showing your support for the Clintons.
zh: 作为一名民主党人，表达对克林顿夫妇的支持并没有什么错。

source: Those few who pay close attention admire your integrity and avoidance of regional favoritism on this issue. Except for those who live in New England of course.
zh: 少数密切关注的人钦佩您的正直和在这个问题上避免地区偏袒。当然，住在新英格兰的人除外。

source: If you want to win New Hampshire, supporting this move can't hurt.
zh: 如果你想赢得新罕布什尔州，支持这一举动不会有坏处。

source: Some pro-life and pro-gun groups are concerned about your selection of Colin Powell as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 一些反堕胎和支持枪支团体对你选择科林·鲍威尔作为竞选搭档感到担忧。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Good people don't agree on every issue. Colin Powell understands that we respect life and the 2nd Amendment.
zh: 好人不会在所有问题上都达成一致。科林·鲍威尔理解我们尊重生命和第二修正案。

source: Colin Powell is a uniter, not a divider. I'm serious about working with all types of people to move our country forward.
zh: 科林·鲍威尔是一个单元，而不是一个分隔器。我认真地与各种类型的人合作，推动我们的国家前进。

source: What will happen next is up to you, although most people have some expectations. Tax cuts will certainly be going into effect, and some bills related to gay marriage or LGBTQ+ people in the military will as well. Just keep an eye out for 2004, and don't make the same mistakes as your dad.
zh: 接下来会发生什么取决于你，尽管大多数人都有一些期望。减税肯定会生效，一些与同性婚姻或军队中 LGBTQ+ 人群相关的法案也会生效。留意2004年，不要犯像你父亲一样的错误。

source: Today you have announced the selection of Joe Lieberman as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天你宣布选择乔·利伯曼作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: What is your position on American trade policy? How do you feel about the World Trade Organization or NAFTA?
zh: 您对美国贸易政策持什么立场？您对世界贸易组织或北美自由贸易协定有什么看法？

source: It is November 2nd, only five days before the voting. News has just broken that George Bush was arrested for drunken driving in 1976. What is your response?
zh: 现在是 11 月 2 日，距离投票只剩下五天了。刚刚传出乔治·布什因1976年醉酒驾驶被捕的消息。您有何回应？

source: These agreements are bad because they favor the rights of countries like China and Mexico over those of the United States. I support foreign trade, but I do not support the surrender of America's rights and sovereignty.
zh: 这些协议很糟糕，因为它们有利于中国和墨西哥等国家的权利，而不是美国的权利。我支持对外贸易，但我不支持放弃美国的权利和主权。

source: Free trade is a bulwark of American prosperity. I support our efforts to protect and increase foreign trade.
zh: 自由贸易是美国繁荣的堡垒。我支持我们为保护和增加对外贸易所做的努力。

source: Our prosperity depends on the expansion of trade, especially with neighboring countries like Mexico and Canada. We should also expand our programs to support and retrain workers who are displaced.
zh: 我们的繁荣取决于贸易的扩大，特别是与墨西哥和加拿大等邻国的贸易扩大。我们还应该扩大支持和再培训流离失所工人的计划。

source: These organizations and agreements are a scheme to enrich corporations at the expense of the American worker. Employment and wages will plummet while corporate profits expand.
zh: 这些组织和协议是一项以牺牲美国工人利益为代价来充实企业的计划。就业和工资将大幅下降，而企业利润却会增加。

source: The Clinton Administration has added 23 million jobs to the American economy and unleashed an unprecedented wave of prosperity and innovation. I will continue his policies as President so that all Americans can prosper in the coming years.
zh: 克林顿政府为美国经济增加了 2300 万个就业岗位，并引发了前所未有的繁荣和创新浪潮。作为总统，我将继续执行他的政策，以便所有美国人在未来几年都能繁荣。

source: We must not undo eight years of progress under President Clinton by cutting key programs and squandering the surplus on tax cuts for the rich. My opponent not only lacks experience, but his conservative ideas are out of step with those of the American public.
zh: 我们绝不能通过削减关键计划和将盈余浪费在为富人减税上来抵消总统克林顿领导下八年来取得的进展。我的对手不仅缺乏经验，而且他的保守观念与美国民众的观念格格不入。

source: I stand here tonight as my own man. We have much more work to do to ensure that America's prosperity flows to all of the people. We need more spending for education, infrastructure, and important research. We also need to protect Social Security, Medicare, and the environment.
zh: 今晚我作为我自己的人站在这里。我们还有很多工作要做，以确保美国的繁荣惠及全体人民。我们需要更多的教育、基础设施和重要研究支出。我们还需要保护社会保障、联邦医疗保险和环境。

source: I stand here tonight as my own man. I will work day and night to support the hard-working American people. I will make sure our debt is paid down, and that senior citizens and middle class families are protected into the future. I will protect our most important programs from attacks and budget cuts.
zh: 今晚我作为我自己的人站在这里。我将夜以继日地工作，支持勤劳的美国人民。我将确保我们的债务得到偿还，并确保老年人和中产阶级家庭在未来得到保护。我将保护我们最重要的项目免受攻击和预算削减。

source: We will hammer Bush on his lack of experience and qualifications for the Presidency. We should point to the tactics his operatives used to defeat John McCain as evidence that he is not nearly as moderate and conciliatory as he claims to be. We will point out his connections to America's economic elites.
zh: 我们将严厉批评布什他缺乏担任总统的经验和资格。我们应该指出他的特工用来击败约翰·麦凯恩的策略作为证据，证明他并不像他声称的那样温和和和解。我们将指出他与美国经济精英的联系。

source: Why screw up a good thing? I will campaign on the positive record of Bill Clinton and the Democrats over the past eight years, and pledge to continue those policies. I will appear with Clinton at a few rallies during the campaign to make sure Americans get the message.
zh: 为什么要把一件好事搞砸？我将凭借比尔·克林顿和民主党在过去八年中的积极记录进行竞选，并承诺继续执行这些政策。我将与克林顿一起出现在竞选期间的几次集会上，以确保美国人明白这一信息。

source: It is important to shore up our support from liberal Democrats, especially with Ralph Nader in the race. I will pledge to increase spending on our most valued social programs, continue to increase taxes on high-earners like Clinton did, and I will look for other areas where I can appeal to the left.
zh: 巩固自由民主党的支持非常重要，尤其是在竞选中拉尔夫·纳德。我将承诺增加我们最有价值的社会项目的支出，继续像克林顿那样增加对高收入者的税收，并且我将寻找其他可以吸引左派的领域。

source: We need to establish our independence from the Clinton Administration and let the American people know that I am my own man. I will emphasize my own scandal-free conduct, while pledging to help those Americans who have been left behind during the recent years of prosperity.
zh: 我们需要建立独立于克林顿政府的独立性，并让美国人民知道我是我自己的人。我将强调我自己的无丑闻行为，同时承诺帮助那些在近年来的繁荣中被抛在后面的美国人。

source: Let's give a good speech about how I am the mainstream, liberal candidate who will help hard-working Americans and use our surplus to shore up important government programs.
zh: 让我们好好演讲一下，我是一位主流自由派候选人，他将帮助勤奋的美国人，并利用我们的盈余来支持重要的政府计划。

source: Domestic issues. Let's talk about my plans to protect Social Security, public eduction, and Medicare to ensure the future prosperity of America. Let's remind voters that these are common-sense proposals that appeal to almost everyone.
zh: 国内问题。让我们谈谈我保护社会保障、公共教育和联邦医疗保险的计划，以确保美国未来的繁荣。让我们提醒选民，这些都是常识性的提案，几乎对所有人都有吸引力。

source: We need to attack George Bush's views on the environment, on energy, on taxes, on spending, and on the right direction for our country. He is out of touch with the American people.
zh: 我们需要攻击乔治·布什对环境、能源、税收、支出以及我国正确方向的看法。他与美国人民脱节。

source: I will emphasize my record and experience as Vice President to Bill Clinton. Voters are satisfied with the economy and direction of the country, and it is my job to continue the policies that have led to our current prosperity.
zh: 我将向比尔·克林顿强调我作为副总裁的记录和经验。选民对国家的经济和方向感到满意，我的工作就是继续执行导致我们目前繁荣的政策。

source: I will spend the end of my campaign with my running mate in Florida. This state will be critical to our chances.
zh: 我将在佛罗里达州中与我的竞选搭档一起度过竞选的最后阶段。这种状态对于我们的机会至关重要。

source: I will appear in Pennsylvania and spend the latter half of the day in Ohio. These are two huge states that we can secure.
zh: 我将出现在宾夕法尼亚州中，并在俄亥俄州中度过后半天。这是我们可以确保的两个巨大国家。

source: We need to focus on states like Missouri, Tennessee, and Arkansas. Clinton may have won them four years ago, but they seem to be wavering this time around.
zh: 我们需要关注密苏里州、田纳西州和阿肯色州等状态。克林顿可能在四年前赢得了他们，但这一次他们似乎摇摆不定。

source: I will hold a press conference and ask the American people what else George Bush is lying about. Not only did he admit to cocaine use, but now he has been caught red-handed attempting to hide a DUI arrest.
zh: 我将召开新闻发布会，询问美国人民乔治·布什还撒谎了什么。他不仅承认吸食可卡因，而且现在还因试图隐瞒酒驾被捕而被当场抓获。

source: I will remind the American people that this election is about the issues of who will better lead the nation. Personal foibles like a DUI arrest in 1976 should not factor into the voting.
zh: 我会提醒美国人民，这次选举关乎谁将更好地领导国家的问题。像 1976 年酒后驾车被捕这样的个人缺点不应该成为投票的因素。

source: This isn't an appropriate story for me to comment on. I will stick to the issues in my campaign speeches, and my spokesperson will issue a brief denial that we had anything to do with the timing of this revelation.
zh: 这不是一个适合我评论的故事。我将在竞选演讲中坚持讨论这些问题，我的发言人将简短否认我们与这一披露的时间有任何关系。

source: I can't speak to the conduct of Bill Clinton in office. I am my own man, running my own campaign for President. To emphasize my independence, I am not accepting Clinton's offer to make campaign appearances on my behalf.
zh: 我无法评论比尔·克林顿在办公室的行为。我是我自己的人，我自己竞选总统。为了强调我的独立性，我不接受克林顿代表我参加竞选活动的提议。

source: Bill Clinton is one of the best Presidents we have had in recent memory. His Administration added 23 million jobs and oversaw a booming economy, and I have nothing but good things to say about it.
zh: 比尔·克林顿是我们最近记忆中最好的总统之一。他的政府增加了 2300 万个就业岗位，并实现了蓬勃发展的经济，对此我只能说好话。

source: His policies were good, but I was disappointed by the personal scandals of recent years. To emphasize that I am different, I will appear frequently with my own wife, and will not shy away from expressing my affection publicly.
zh: 他的政策很好，但我对近年来的个人丑闻感到失望。为了强调我的与众不同，我会经常和自己的妻子一起出现，并且不会回避公开表达我的爱意。

source: Joe Lieberman is a historic choice for Vice President, and a valued member of the Democratic Party.
zh: 乔·利伯曼是副总统的历史性选择，也是民主党的重要成员。

source: Joe Lieberman is an independent thinker who has challenged people of all views. These are the people I want in my administration.
zh: 乔·利伯曼是一位独立的思想家，挑战了各种观点的人。这些是我想要加入我的政府的人。

source: Free trade is an issue that unites the left and far-right in opposition. On the other hand, both main parties generally support it.
zh: 自由贸易是一个将左翼和极右翼联合起来的问题。另一方面，两大主要政党普遍支持。

source: Millions of satisfied Americans are watching you embrace the legacy of Clinton and pledge to continue it.
zh: 数百万满意的美国人正在看着您拥抱克林顿的遗产并承诺继续下去。

source: Good combination of embracing Clinton and attacking Bush.
zh: 拥抱克林顿和攻击布什的良好结合。

source: This could work, and maybe you'll remind the Nader crowd why they should hold their nose and vote for you.
zh: 这可能会起作用，也许你会提醒纳德人群为什么他们应该捂住鼻子投票给你。

source: It's rarely a bad idea to tie your fortunes to the popular Bill Clinton.
zh: 将你的财富与流行的比尔·克林顿联系起来并不是一个坏主意。

source: This is an interesting strategy, but maybe not the best. Some think you are pushing yourself too far from the center to win a national election.
zh: 这是一个有趣的策略，但可能不是最好的。有些人认为，为了赢得全国大选，你将自己推离了中心太远。

source: This strategy isn't a disaster, but why work so hard to distance yourself from a popular, successful President who you worked under?
zh: 这个策略并不是一场灾难，但为什么要如此努力地与你工作过的一位受欢迎、成功的总统保持距离呢？

source: This is not the best response to a revelation that should be hurting Bush. By inserting yourself into things, you've not helped your image heading into the election.
zh: 这不是对应该伤害布什的揭露的最佳回应。如果你把自己融入到事情中，并没有帮助你在选举中的形象。

source: Why let Bush off the hook like that? You look almost too magnanimous heading into Election Day.
zh: 为什么让布什这样摆脱困境？临近选举日，你看起来太宽宏大量了。

source: This is probably your best bet. Bush might lose a few votes, but there's nothing you can do to pile on.
zh: 这可能是您最好的选择。布什可能会失去一些选票，但你无能为力。

source: Today you have announced the selection of Bob Graham as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择鲍勃·格雷厄姆作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Is it true that you claimed to have invented the internet?
zh: 您声称发明了互联网，这是真的吗？

source: What do you have to say about the candidacy of Ralph Nader?
zh: 对于拉尔夫·纳德的候选资格您有什么想说的？

source: I think this is a naive, misguided campaign that will split liberal support and risks putting George W. Bush in the White House. I will attack Nader's campaign and call upon him to withdraw.
zh: 我认为这是一场天真的、误导性的运动，它会分裂自由派的支持，并冒着将乔治·W.·布什放入白宫的风险。我将攻击纳德的竞选活动并呼吁他退出。

source: You don't punch down in politics. I will run my own campaign and trust that the voters will be smart enough to reject the Green Party in November.
zh: 你不会在政治上打压。我将开展自己的竞选活动，并相信选民会足够聪明，在 11 月拒绝绿党。

source: We shouldn't mention Nader by name, but it wouldn't be a bad idea to emphasize the more liberal aspects of our platform to reduce his support.
zh: 我们不应该提及纳德的名字，但强调我们政治纲领更自由的方面以减少他的支持也不是一个坏主意。

source: Maybe I didn't personally sit down and invent the internet. But I was crucial in fighting for the funding that allowed our universities to build this system.
zh: 也许我并没有亲自坐下来发明互联网。但我在争取让我们的大学能够建立这个系统的资金方面发挥了至关重要的作用。

source: This is misrepresentation of what I said. I never claimed to invent the internet, I was merely pointing out that government research which I supported as a Senator was a crucial piece of the equation.
zh: 这是对我所说内容的歪曲。我从未声称发明了互联网，我只是指出我作为参议员支持的政府研究是其中的关键部分。

source: This is a petty, personal attack, designed to distract from the real issues facing our country.
zh: 这是一次微不足道的人身攻击，旨在分散人们对我们国家面临的真正问题的注意力。

source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He has fought tirelessly for education and the environment.
zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆很好地服务了他的家乡佛罗里达州。他为教育和环境不懈奋斗。

source: Bob Graham has served his home state of Florida well. He is the type of independent thinker we need in the White House.
zh: 鲍勃·格雷厄姆很好地服务了他的家乡佛罗里达州。他是我们白宫中需要的那种独立思考者。

source: It does not help your stature to be attacking a third-party candidate like Ralph Nader.
zh: 攻击像拉尔夫·纳德这样的第三方候选人对你的地位没有任何帮助。

source: This is probably a good approach.
zh: 这可能是一个好方法。

source: Today you have announced the selection of John Kerry as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择约翰·克里作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: John Kerry is the type of principled, liberal thinker we need in our administration. He has worked tirelessly on behalf of all Americans.
zh:
约翰·克里是我们的政府需要的那种有原则、自由的思想家。他为所有美国人不懈地努力。
然而，

source: John Kerry is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again over his years in the Senate.
zh: 约翰·克里是这项工作的最佳人选。在参议院任职期间，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

source: Today you have announced the selection of Evan Bayh as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择埃文·贝赫作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Evan Bayh is the best person for the job. He has proven his ability time and time again as a Governor and Senator.
zh: 埃文·贝赫是这项工作的最佳人选。作为州长和参议员，他一次又一次证明了自己的能力。

source: Evan Bayh has served his home state of Indiana well. He is an independent thinker who consistently seeks bipartisan solutions.
zh: 埃文·贝赫很好地服务了他的家乡印第安纳州。他是一位独立的思想家，始终寻求两党合作的解决方案。

source: The most important priority is to prevent the election of George W. Bush to President. I will not put my name on the ballot in any contested state. I expect that people in other places will see that a vote for me symbolizes a vote for a new kind of politics in the long term.
zh: 最重要的优先事项是阻止乔治·W.·布什当选总统。在任何有争议的州，我不会把我的名字写在选票上。我希望其他地方的人们会看到，从长远来看，投票给我象征着投票给一种新型政治。

source: The two parties are almost the same on every major issue. Neither supports meaningful campaign finance reform, universal health care, free college education, a peaceful foreign policy, or the protection of American workers. I present a true alternative to the American people.
zh: 两党在每一个重大问题上几乎都是一致的。两者都不支持有意义的竞选财务改革、全民医疗保健、免费大学教育、和平外交政策或保护美国工人。我向美国人民提出了一个真正的选择。

source: If victory for the left means eight years of Bill Clinton and a term for Al Gore, then it is a shallow victory indeed. Bill Clinton has pushed cherished Republican proposals like NAFTA and welfare reform to fruition. I will end this betrayal of the American worker.
zh: 如果左派的胜利意味着八年的比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔的任期，那么这确实是一次肤浅的胜利。比尔·克林顿推动了诸如北美自由贸易协定等备受珍视的共和党提案和福利改革的成果。我将结束这种对美国工人的背叛。

source: I am the true choice for Americans concerned about the environment and Social Security. I will enact strict regulation of the oil and coal industry, fight against big agriculture and GMO's, and support research and subsidies for alternative energy. I will increase funding and benefits for Social Security.
zh: 我是关心环境的美国人的真正选择社会保障。我将对石油和煤炭行业实施严格监管，打击大农业和转基因生物，并支持替代能源的研究和补贴。我将增加社会保障的资金和福利。

source: We will run a national campaign and gather as many votes as possible towards our goal of becoming a viable third-party. I will tell liberal Americans to resist the urge to vote for Al Gore, by reminding them of the many ways in which he does not differ from Republicans.
zh: 我们将开展一场全国性的竞选活动，并收集尽可能多的选票，以实现成为可行的第三方的目标。我将提醒自由派美国人，提醒他们他与共和党人在许多方面没有什么不同，从而抵制投票给阿尔·戈尔的冲动。

source: The best way to gather votes is to run up our totals in liberal states like New York, Massachusetts, and California. We will focus on these areas heavily.
zh: 收集选票的最佳方法是增加纽约州、马萨诸塞州和加利福尼亚州等自由主义州的总数。我们将重点关注这些领域。

source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American worker through trade agreements like NAFTA and a lack of protection for American industry. My campaign will focus on opponents of globalization who have no one else to vote for.
zh: 我将广泛关注共和党和民主党如何通过北美自由贸易协定等贸易协定以及对美国工业缺乏保护来背叛美国工人。我的竞选活动将把重点放在全球化的反对者身上，因为他们没有其他人可以投票。

source: I will focus extensively on how Republicans and Democrats alike have betrayed the American environment. I will hammer on the themes of carbon emissions, GMO crops, giveaways to corporations, and other areas where both parties have failed the American people.
zh: 我将广泛关注共和党人和民主党人如何背叛美国环境。我将重点讨论碳排放、转基因作物、向企业提供赠品以及双方都令美国人民失望的其他领域的主题。

source: Let's give a good speech about the need for big changes to American politics and society. I will remind voters that the Democrats and Republicans are two sides of the same corporate policies, and attack Al Gore's pretensions to stand for the American worker.
zh: 让我们就美国政治和社会进行重大变革的必要性发表一篇精彩的演讲。我会提醒选民，民主党和共和党是同一公司政策的两个方面，并攻击阿尔·戈尔自称代表美国工人的行为。

source: Let's talk about how we are allowing large corporations to ruin the American environment for their own profits, while everyday people suffer from pollution, unclean water, and a dangerous lack of regulation on food and prescription drugs.
zh: 让我们谈谈我们如何允许大公司为了自身利益而破坏美国的环境，而普通人却遭受着污染、不干净的水以及对食品和处方药缺乏监管的危险。

source: Let's emphasize that both Democrats and Republicans have sold out the American worker to the interests of corporations. I will remind people of NAFTA, the WTO protests, and other decisions that have decimated American manufacturing.
zh: 让我们强调一下，民主党人和共和党人都为了企业的利益而出卖了美国工人。我会提醒人们北美自由贸易协定、世贸组织的抗议以及其他摧毁美国制造业的决定。

source: I will attack George Bush relentlessly. I will expose Bush as a phony and an elitist, corporatist conservative and not as the moderate that he presents himself as.
zh: 我会毫不留情地攻击乔治·布什。我将揭露布什是一个虚伪的精英主义者、社团主义保守派，而不是他所表现的温和派。

source: I will visit states like Ohio, Michigan, and Pennsylvania that have been especially hard hit by global trade agreements and the outsourcing of manufacturing jobs.
zh: 我将访问俄亥俄州、密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州等州，这些州受到全球贸易协定和制造业工作外包的打击尤其严重。

source: The last few days will be business as usual. My goal is to bring my message to all parts of America, whether it be in close states or those that clearly tilt towards one of the main candidates.
zh: 最后几天一切如常。我的目标是将我的信息传达给美国各地，无论是在关系密切的州还是那些明显倾向于主要候选人之一的州。

source: I will hold massive rallies in New York and try to run up my vote total in the left-leaning, uncontested states of that region. People should not be afraid to vote for me.
zh: 我将在纽约州举行大规模集会，并尝试在该地区左倾、无争议的州增加我的选票总数。人们不应该害怕投票给我。

source: This is the type of non-issue that is indicative of the broken American political system. George Bush was wrong for America before this news broke, and he is still wrong for America.
zh: 这是一种非问题类型，表明美国政治体系已支离破碎。在这个消息传出之前，乔治·布什对美国来说是错误的，而且他对美国来说仍然是错误的。

source: Interesting campaign strategy. But you will lose a good number of votes in states like Florida and Ohio, and every little bit helps if you want to hit 5% nationally.
zh: 有趣的竞选策略。但在佛罗里达州和俄亥俄州等州，您将失去大量选票，如果您想在全国范围内达到 5%，那么每一点选票都会有所帮助。

source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- will people turn out to vote for you in close states? Time will tell.
zh: 这是您竞选活动中的重大决定之一 - 人们会在相近的州投票给您吗？时间会证明一切。

source: This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- can you run up your vote total in large, liberal states to hit the 5% threshold nationally? Time will tell.
zh: 这是您竞选活动中的重大决定之一 - 您能否在大型自由州增加您的选票总数，以达到全国范围内 5% 的门槛？时间会证明一切。

source: There might be a market for anti-globalization views in these states, but they also might be very close on election night. Will left-wing voters risk a vote on you instead of Gore?
zh: 这些州可能存在反全球化观点的市场，但它们在选举之夜也可能非常接近。左翼选民会冒险投票给你而不是戈尔吗？

source: There's nothing wrong with sticking to the usual program.
zh: 坚持通常的计划并没有什么问题。

source: You give a passionate speech to 20,000 screaming supporters on the Saturday before the election. Will it help?
zh: 您在选举前的周六向 20,000 名尖叫的支持者发表了热情洋溢的演讲。有帮助吗？

source: Regardless of the recent news, it looks like Bush has received a solid bounce heading into election night. But you might get a few more votes if Gore looks to be losing.
zh: 不管最近的消息如何，看起来布什在选举之夜已经获得了强劲的反弹。但如果戈尔看起来会失败，您可能会获得更多选票。

source: It doesn't seem like this revelation has changed much. If the election is close, some voters might jump to Gore instead of you.
zh: 这个启示似乎没有太大改变。如果选举结果接近，一些选民可能会跳到戈尔而不是您。

source: It looks like Gore has received a solid bounce heading into election night. This might help you pick up a few wavering votes.
zh: 看起来戈尔在选举之夜已经获得了强劲的反弹。这可能会帮助你赢得一些摇摆不定的选票。
